zh-CN.title: 运营者任免通知
items: 设置或取消运营者时，官方账号会通过私聊向对应用户发送通知
通知会同步进入会话未读与消息提醒，并根据用户语言展示

en.title: Operator role notifications
items: The official account now sends a direct message whenever an operator role is assigned or removed
These notices appear in unread chats and notifications, localized to the member's language
